output.reason: The brief backs up its main claim with a clear Kestrel split (8 of 11 Kestrel associates left versus 1 of 13 others), so it is right to rule out a group-wide pay fix, and it recommends a cheap next step: the £9k confidential interviews. It is honest that it cannot yet tell whether workload or Faulk's supervision is the cause, although waiting about three weeks keeps a heavy, possibly harmful situation in place a little longer.
